title: Windows Job Object provider process boundary
description: Objective: provide the real per-run Windows process primitive required by the Claude launcher. Deliverable: an internal @moe/runner Node/Windows binding that creates the provider child suspended, attaches it to a dedicated Job Object configured with JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE and no breakaway, then resumes it; exposes shell-free argv launch, bounded cwd/environment/stdio, proven process identity, awaited exit, terminate, and handle closure. A taskkill-only implementation is not sufficient because it cannot prove descendants dead after the root exits. NOT in scope: Claude runtime discovery/pinning, activation grants, daemon/store orchestration, evidence receipts, or public @moe/runner launcher export. Real consumer: Windows Claude launch wrapper task task-acf73253a204435aba590894799814f2. Owned paths: a focused packages/runner/src/platform/windows/** binding/test seam plus the minimal runner manifest/lockfile/native-build paths selected during planning. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/runner test plus a Windows parent+grandchild termination smoke.
definitionOfDone: On Windows, the provider process is created suspended and cannot execute before a dedicated Job Object is created, configured kill-on-close without breakaway, and successfully receives the child; only then is the child resumed.

Every create/configure/assign/resume/query/terminate/close failure returns an immutable UNKNOWN result with an exact stable PROCESS_BOUNDARY code and refusing layer; partial children are terminated and every native/process/stream handle is awaited and closed.

Launch accepts an executable plus argv array with shell disabled and validates a bounded absolute cwd and allowlisted bounded environment; malformed, oversized, UNC/device, or unverifiable inputs produce exact refusal codes before process creation.

Closing/cancelling/timing out the boundary kills the controlled parent and a deliberately detached grandchild; tests prove both PIDs terminate and assert a positive generated case count plus the exact code/layer for every refusal arm.

Non-Windows import is safe and invocation returns typed UNSUPPORTED with zero native/process calls; the chosen native dependency/helper is version-pinned and runtime-loadable on the supported Windows Node version.
The focused runner gates and a foreground Windows process-tree smoke exit 0, with no generated addon/build/debug artifacts committed.
taskRails: Use Microsoft Job Object semantics; taskkill-only or PID-enumeration-only cleanup cannot satisfy proven whole-tree termination.
TDD; failure tests assert exact stable code and layer and zero process execution where refusal precedes creation.
Keep every production source focused, target <=250 physical lines and split before 400; stage and commit only explicit owned paths.
This is an internal process boundary. Do not add daemon/store authority or claim durable activation-grant consumption.
